recognize_zh: 高倍下畫面中央橫走一條淡藍色纖維狀帶，帶上排列著細長卵圓形、染色質均勻的內皮細胞核，兩旁擁擠著成熟中的骨髓細胞，這是骨髓抹片中微血管的高倍外觀。
features: Horizontal band of pale blue fibrillar/cytoplasmic material crossing the field
Elongated oval to spindle nuclei with smooth fine chromatin aligned along the band (endothelial cells)
No nucleoli or significant atypia in the aligned nuclei
Crowded surrounding myeloid precursors and erythroid cells with normal morphology
Thick area of smear with overlapping cells
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows a band of pale blue fibrillar material running across the field, along which elongated oval and spindle-shaped nuclei with smooth, evenly distributed chromatin are aligned. These nuclei lack nucleoli and atypia, and represent endothelial cells of a capillary. The surrounding hematopoietic cells, including myeloid and erythroid precursors, show normal morphology. Findings represent a normal bone marrow capillary.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are larger, cohesive and polygonal with coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and nuclear molding, unlike bland aligned endothelial nuclei.
Mast cells contain dense metachromatic granules and often oval central nuclei, while endothelial cells here are agranular.
A disrupted megakaryocyte shows a large lobulated single nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not multiple separate spindle nuclei.
